svg.title: The Holy Earth Foundation. Plants & Miracles.
svg.desc: The foundation's mark, a golden heart within a circle of light, at the heart of a breathing Golden Halo whose rays slowly turn; the heart's four rays end in the compass points, north, east, south and west, lettered N, E, S and W, breathing with the halo. A forest before dawn. The Vine of the Soul, a twin-stranded liana of sky and gold with paired leaves, tendrils and small pink-white blossoms, grows around the frame and lives: its strands sway, its leaves and blossoms breathe, its tendrils curl, and light rises in it from the root both ways round to meet beside the heart; fireflies drift. I am one Self, united with my Creator.
